meta.bookTitle: Monthly TDS Log – Office Rent, Staff Salaries, Income & Expenses, Bookkeeping & TDS
meta.bookNote: One column per payment month (BS, Shrawan → Asadh). Enter data only in the YELLOW cells. Office rent is paid in advance and salaries are disbursed in the first week – enter each person's NET payment once paid. TDS must be deposited and e-TDS filed by the 25th of the FOLLOWING month. Amounts in NPR; dates as 2083-06-05 or normal dates. Totals, gross, SST and net surplus calculate automatically. Rent TDS is NOT a monthly item – it is paid once a year at Ward renewal (see '4 Ward Renewal').

guides.title: ANNUAL FINANCIAL AUDIT
guides.subtitle: Audit report for the financial year that just closed – the foundation for every other filing

glance.authority: Registered auditor (ICAN member) appointed by the Board / AGM
glance.frequency: Annual – for the previous fiscal year
glance.window: Shrawan – Bhadra (books closed in Shrawan; report signed by end of Bhadra)
glance.dependsOn: Closed books, bank certificates, complete supporting vouchers
glance.feedsInto: Income-tax return, Tax Clearance, OCR, SWC renewal, Tax Exemption, donor reporting
glance.output: Signed audit report + audited financial statements (hard & soft copy)

steps.details: Post all entries up to Asadh end. Reconcile HBL and Sanima bank accounts, cash, advances, payroll and TDS ledgers. Finalise fixed-asset register.
Apply to HBL and Sanima for statements, balance certificates / confirmations (call & current accounts), FD certificates, interest and TDS certificates.
Summary of income & expenditure; salary statement; office rent & utilities statement; income breakdown; SWC approvals with donor MoUs; VAT/TDS records; vouchers.
Share the complete bookkeeping and supporting files. Ask the Auditor for a written list of required documents and keep a log.
Answer queries within 2–3 days. Keep a query log (question, answer, date, evidence). Delays here delay Tax Clearance, OCR and SWC.
Check totals against your books, grants, TDS / VAT figures and notes. Ask for a management letter if issued.
steps.remarks: Some errors found, auditor is revising the draft

steps.details: Auditor signs the report. Pay the audit fee and deduct TDS on it (deposit by the 25th of next month).
Present audited accounts to the Board / AGM for approval and record it in the minutes.
Auditor completes the audit verification / e-TDS related work on the IRD system (Auditor's responsibility – confirm it is done).
Save signed copies in the Audit folder. Share with the Tax Clearance, OCR, SWC and Tax Exemption tasks.

docs.notes: Full FY, HBL and Sanima (call & current accounts)
Needed to match interest income and TDS credit

docs.document: Hostel fees, tuition fees & admission fees sheet

docs.notes: Donors, individuals, interest, Fellows' contributions, etc.

tips: •  Late or incomplete bookkeeping is the #1 cause of delay across the whole compliance chain – close books in the first two weeks of Shrawan.
•  Never let the audit report be finalised before rent and salary TDS are fully deposited; mismatches surface again at Tax Clearance.
•  Audit documents Dropbox folder (from draft): open link
Always confirm current-year forms, deadlines and fees with the relevant authority before submitting.

guides.title: TAX RETURN & TAX CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE
guides.subtitle: File the annual income-tax return, then obtain the Tax Clearance Certificate from the Inland Revenue Office

glance.authority: Inland Revenue Office (IRD) where PAN is registered
glance.window: Return: Bhadra – Ashwin (statutory: about 3 months after FY-end – verify). Clearance: Ashwin – Kartik
glance.dependsOn: Signed & verified audit report; all TDS / VAT deposited and filed
glance.feedsInto: OCR update, SWC renewal, Tax Exemption renewal, Ward & bank files

steps.details: Signed audit report and audited financial statements in hand; Auditor has completed IRD verification.
Match salary, rent and other TDS deposits with the IRD portal for all 12 months. Regularise any missing months before applying (see Salary TDS guide).
File on the IRD system through the Auditor. Save the acknowledgement. Confirm the current-year deadline with IRD / Auditor.
Application letter for the Tax Clearance Certificate, signed by the Director / Board as per your practice.
Return acknowledgement, audited FS (Annex 2 & 13), TDS / e-TDS records, payment receipts including VAT bills, previous clearance, exemption certificate, PAN, updated OCR, Ward & SWC certificates.
Submit the application and documents at the Inland Revenue Office; keep a stamped copy or reference number.
Respond quickly to clarifications; bring the Auditor if needed. Pay any assessed dues and keep the receipt.
Collect the certificate, scan it, save in the Tax folder and share with OCR, SWC and Tax Exemption tasks.

docs.document: Application letter signed by Board / Director
docs.notes: Addressed to the Inland Revenue Office
As per draft checklist – confirm annexes with Auditor
Staff Salary with TDS calculation and print in Samaanta Letterhead, get signed by Board

tips: •  Tax exemption does not remove TDS obligations – IRD will check TDS compliance before issuing clearance.
•  Plan for 2–4 weeks in IRD; start the application immediately after the return is filed.
•  Confirm current-year forms and annexes with the Auditor – requirements change with each Finance Act.
Always confirm current-year forms, deadlines and fees with the relevant authority before submitting.

guides.title: GOVERNANCE – BOARD MEETINGS, AGM & RECORDS

glance.frequency: Quarterly meetings; AGM annually; records ongoing

steps.details: Fix the four quarterly meetings and the AGM date in Shrawan and share with all directors.

howto: 1.  On the Dashboard, choose the CURRENT Nepali month (cell F6). Timing flags, KPIs and 'This month's focus' update automatically.
2.  Use the Annual Calendar to see the whole year at a glance; use the Task Tracker to update Status, dates and follow-ups after every action.
3.  Open a step guide (tabs 1-11) for the detailed process and document checklist of each area. Mark steps Done and documents Ready.
4.  Every month record office rent, staff salaries, income & expenses, bookkeeping status and TDS deposit in the Monthly TDS Log. Deposit and e-TDS filing are due by the 25th of the following month.
5.  Save each final form, payment receipt, acknowledgement and certificate in the matching folder of the digital Compliance folder (see sections 6 and 9 – Dropbox links).
6.  Deadlines and forms change – confirm current IRD, OCR, SWC and Ward requirements before each submission.

overview.folderStructure: One master folder (with a backup copy) containing sub-folders:  01 Audit  •  02 Tax (Return, Clearance, Exemption)  •  03 OCR  •  04 Ward  •  05 SWC (Renewal, Program Approval)  •  06 Bank KYC (HBL, Sanima)  •  07 Payroll & Rent TDS  •  08 Governance (Minutes, Registers)  •  09 This tracker.  For every submission save the final form, payment receipt, acknowledgement / reference number and final certificate.  Paste every folder link in section 9 below.

handover.detail: Review Dashboard, Calendar, Tracker and every step guide with the successor
Record where originals are kept: OCR, PAN, SWC, Tax Exemption, Tax Clearance, Ward, lease agreement
IRD, CAMIS, SWC and bank portals: list who holds each login (never store passwords in this file) and transfer ownership
Update authorised / contact person at IRD, OCR, SWC, HBL and Sanima Bank; remove outgoing officer as signatory where applicable
Share the full Compliance folder and backup- Dropbox
Introduce successor to Auditor, Lawyer, Landlord, Ward Office, SWC and bank relationship managers
Hand over the monthly TDS routine; confirm the last filed month and regularise past unfiled months
Brief on tasks marked In Progress / Past window on the Dashboard (currently Audit, Tax Clearance, etc.)
Confirm SWC, Tax Exemption, Ward and lease expiry dates are entered in the tracker and guides

SWC renewal set, certificates, fee receipts
Program proposals, approval letters, donor MoUs
Salary sheets, TDS vouchers, e-TDS acknowledgements, rent agreement & receipts
Monthly vouchers, bank statements, income & expense summaries
Board / AGM minutes, resolutions, registers, bank mandates
Latest copy of this file + previous years

overview.folderTip: Tip: in Dropbox use  Share ▸ Copy link  on the folder and paste it into the yellow cell. Store only links here – never passwords. If a folder is moved, update the link once here and every sheet follows.
overview.startTip: 9. DROPBOX FILE LOCATIONS  (paste each Dropbox folder link into the yellow cells – the Task Tracker and every step guide pick it up automatically)
